Usage: gacli skills install [options]

Install the gacli skill into one or more AI CLI agents

Options:
  --agent <agent>  Target agent: claude, codex, qwen, gemini, or all
  --scope <scope>  Install scope: user (default), project, or a custom path
                   (default: "user")
  --name <name>    Installed skill directory name (default: "gacli")
  --dry-run        Show what would happen without writing anything
  --force          Overwrite an existing install
  --no-detect      Skip auto-detection prompts; require --agent
  -h, --help       display help for command
